Load the deployment skill whenever its text is not in your context: at the start of any session that uses Turf, before any other turf tool, after the conversation was summarized, and before answering a question about a plan, an approval, a convergence, a turf action or a Turf error. Running a configuration — the convergence (up → review the vended plan → apply by its digest, round after round), approval, every outcome, taking up a convergence, turf actions, deferrals, drift, recovery, workspaces and credentials, and the /up and /destroy runbooks.

**[Tiers](/docs/reference/server/#tiers):** read · plan · apply · full
